notes:
v0.6.39: document the "do not sudo python3 the launcher" footgun.

On 2026-09-09 15:44 MDT, the operator reported that the
modem73 TUI "does not stay running". Root cause turned out
to be a self-inflicted footgun: an earlier `sudo python3
/home/pi/shared_launcher/app.py` invocation had left an
orphan root process holding :80, so systemd's
g90-shared-launcher.service ExecStart kept failing with
"Address already in use" and entered a 283-iteration
restart loop. The visible launcher was the orphan root
process, so Popen()'d children (lxterminal, modem73,
freedvtnc2) ran as root and were invisible to the pi
user's noVNC tab — which is why the operator clicked
"Modem73 TUI: Start" and saw nothing.

Fix:
- Killed the orphan root python3 (sudo kill 47581 47584).
  systemd immediately took over and ran the launcher as
  User=pi, which is the correct state.
- Added a long warning comment to
  g90-image/systemd-units/g90-shared-launcher.service
  documenting the footgun: do not `sudo python3 ...` the
  launcher; use `sudo systemctl restart ...` instead.
- Documented the recovery procedure (pkill the orphan,
  systemctl restart) for next time it happens.

The modem73 TUI now works as expected. Same fix unblocks
freedvtnc2 Chat and any other UI button that launches a
Popen child.
